questions.prompt: Which of these people were Roman emperors?
questions.fact: Hadrian's Wall took about six years to build across northern Britain, and much of it still stands.

questions.prompt: Which of these instruments have strings?
questions.fact: A concert harp has 47 strings and seven pedals, each of which retunes a whole set of strings at once.

questions.prompt: How many years did the Hundred Years' War actually last?
questions.fact: 116 years, from 1337 to 1453, with long truces in between. The name came later.

questions.prompt: How many keys does a standard piano have?
questions.fact: 88: 52 white and 36 black, a range settled on in the 1880s and never changed.

questions.prompt: Who painted the ceiling of the Sistine Chapel?
questions.hint: He considered himself a sculptor, not a painter.
questions.fact: Michelangelo painted it standing on scaffolding, craning upward, over four years from 1508.

questions.prompt: Which language has the most native speakers?
questions.hint: Not the most learned, the most born into.
questions.fact: Mandarin has around 940 million native speakers. English has more speakers in total once second languages are counted.
